description: WindInput, an open-source Chinese IME for Windows built on Rust + TSF, supporting Wubi 86 / full pinyin / double pinyin, auxiliary codes, and emoji
post_install: elseif ($li) { Write-Host "ERROR: $link exists and is not a junction; remove it manually." -f Red }
Write-Host 'Registering WindInput TSF via junction (confirm the UAC prompt)...' -f Cyan
Write-Host 'TSF already junction-registered, starting engine directly...' -f Cyan
Write-Host 'Migrating TSF registration to junction (confirm TWO UAC prompts)...' -f Cyan
if ($p.ExitCode -ne 0) { Write-Host 'wind_portable.exe -stop failed; continuing anyway.' -f Yellow }
if ($p.ExitCode -ne 0) { Write-Host "wind_portable.exe -start failed; run '$link\wind_portable.exe -start' manually." -f Yellow }
pre_uninstall: if ($procs) { Write-Host 'Stopping WindInput processes...' -f Cyan; $procs | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

script: # $old_version only exists on scoop-update's uninstall path (scoop-update.ps1:262);
# keep TSF registration and junction across updates, new post_install restarts the engine.
Write-Host 'Update detected, keeping TSF registration and junction.' -f Cyan
Write-Host 'Unregistering WindInput TSF (confirm the UAC prompt)...' -f Cyan
if ($proc.ExitCode -ne 0) { Write-Host "wind_portable.exe -stop exited with code $($proc.ExitCode); TSF registration may remain (run 'wind_portable.exe -stop' manually)." -f Yellow }
Write-Host 'WindInput TSF not registered (or launcher missing), skipping unregister.'

notes: Install/update are fully automatic: post_install registers and starts the engine via %LOCALAPPDATA%\WindInput (a junction pointing to this app's current directory, created and cleaned up by the manifest — do not delete it manually); fresh registration requires one UAC confirmation, while already-registered installs (including updates) start the engine directly with zero UAC.
After install, switch to 'WindInput' with Win+Space; open settings via wind_setting.exe or the launcher tray menu.

Updates: the resident engine process runs from the junction path, outside the scoop app directory, so it does not trigger scoop's busy check — just run scoop update windinput (it stops the process, keeps the registration, restarts the engine, zero UAC). Close the wind_setting window and the launcher tray before updating — if launched from the scoop directory they are still caught by the busy check. If the registration path fell back after running -start manually from the scoop directory, the next install/update migrates it back to the junction (requires two UAC confirmations).

Uninstall: just run scoop uninstall windinput; pre_uninstall stops the related processes, then the uninstaller pops a UAC prompt to unregister the TSF and remove autostart, and also removes the %LOCALAPPDATA%\WindInput junction.

Portable user data lives in-place in the userdata directory (config.toml settings, custom words and word frequency in userdata\data, custom themes in userdata\themes) and is persisted; the data directory holds read-only dictionary/theme resources shipped with each release, is not persisted, and dictionaries are updated automatically on scoop upgrade.

Trusted Mode games (e.g. CS2) only load signed DLLs from the system directory: follow the official wind-portable instructions and create an empty file named system_deploy in the program root to switch to system deployment mode (rare cases; takes effect after -stop then -start).
Report IME engine issues upstream: https://github.com/huanfeng/WindInput
